svg.title: What GPU Deck supports
svg.desc: Drive it with: Web UI, Desktop app, CLI, Terraform, REST API, Any AI gateway in front. Compatible APIs: OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama. Model types: Chat and thinking, Vision, Embeddings, Rerank, Speech-to-text, Text-to-speech, Image, Video. In the middle, GPU Deck (control plane on one cpu server): Fleet, Placement, Rules, Layouts, Swaps, Routing, Metrics, Alerts. Inference engines: vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, TensorRT-LLM, MLX, mlx-audio, vLLM-Omni, SGLang Diffusion, whisper.cpp, stable-diffusion.cpp, Custom container. Verified on real hardware: vLLM, llama.cpp, MLX. Partial on real hardware: SGLang, TensorRT-LLM. Accelerators: NVIDIA, AMD, Apple Silicon, Hygon, MetaX, Moore Threads, T-Head, CPU only. Verified on real hardware: NVIDIA, Apple Silicon. Where it runs: On-prem bare metal, VMs, Kubernetes (Helm), AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, DigitalOcean, Air-gapped.
